cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: You Handle the Impossible Part
cards.instruction: Make someone accept responsibility for the one part of the plan that cannot reasonably be done.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Put yesterday's missing hour in this jar before lunch. Please.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Then loosen the lid. Don't make the opening smaller than necessary.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm labelling. We mustn't confuse it with tomorrow.

mechanism: A directs recovering lost time and agrees to handle the jar while leaving B responsible for determining when an hour has entered it.
confusable: Unlike doing the task after a swap, A takes the possible physical support but preserves B impossible responsibility.
comparison: A private lost-hour recovery differs from a public moonlight blackout and larger work offer.
seedUse: D149-b yesterday hour, jar and lid; S02-b accommodates physical work while keeping B responsible for the impossible part.
